title: SUNDAY MOBILITY
subtitle: SUNDAY. STRETCH-HEAVY, STILL BARKED. GLUTE BRIDGES, SINGLE-LEG HINGE BALANCE, CAT-COW, STAIR HAMSTRING STRETCH, FIGURE-FOUR, WALL CHEST OPENER. OIL THE HINGES BEFORE MONDAY'S WEIGH-IN.

script.welcome: SUNDAY, GRIMES. MOBILITY DAY. SEVENTEEN MINUTES. ONE BIT OF STRENGTH, ONE BIT OF BALANCE, THEN WE STRETCH OUT A WEEK OF DESK CHAIR. SUNDAY IS NOT A DAY OFF. IT IS A DAY OF OIL. GET ON THE FLOOR.
script.rest: REST. LONG BREATH IN, LONGER BREATH OUT. NO PHONE.
script.lastSet: LAST ONE. MAKE IT YOUR BEST. EYES ON YOU.
script.complete: DISMISSED. HIPS OPEN, HAMSTRINGS LONGER, CHEST UNLOCKED, BALANCE TESTED. TOMORROW IS WEIGH IN DAY, SOLDIER. GO EASY ON THE SUNDAY ROAST AND HONEST ON THE SCALE. I'M WATCHING.
script.resume: BACK TO IT. EASY DOES IT.

exercises.name: GLUTE BRIDGES
exercises.cue: LIE ON YOUR BACK, KNEES BENT, FEET FLAT HIP-WIDTH. PRESS THROUGH THE HEELS, SQUEEZE THE GLUTES AND LIFT THE HIPS UNTIL KNEES, HIPS AND SHOULDERS LINE UP. PAUSE 2 SECONDS AT THE TOP. LOWER SLOW. NO ARCHING THE LOW BACK.
exercises.speakStart: GLUTE BRIDGES. THREE SETS OF TWELVE. HEELS DOWN, SQUEEZE THE CHEEKS, HIPS UP. PAUSE TWO AT THE TOP. LOWER SLOW. THAT BACKSIDE HAS BEEN SAT ON ALL WEEK. TIME IT EARNED ITS KEEP.
exercises.speakDone: BRIDGES DONE. ENGINE ROOM SWITCHED ON. GOOD.

exercises.name: SINGLE-LEG HINGE BALANCE
exercises.cue: STAND TALL NEXT TO A CHAIR OR WALL, FINGERTIPS ON IT IF NEEDED. SOFT KNEE ON THE STANDING LEG. HINGE AT THE HIP, TORSO FORWARD, FREE LEG REACHING BACK, BODY LIKE A SEESAW. GO ONLY AS FAR AS YOU CAN STAY SQUARE. RISE SLOW. 5 PER LEG.
exercises.speakStart: SINGLE LEG HINGE. BALANCE WORK. TWO ROUNDS. FIVE EACH LEG. SOFT KNEE, TIP FORWARD, BACK LEG LONG, HIPS SQUARE. FINGERTIPS ON THE CHAIR IS LEGAL. FALLING INTO THE FILING CABINET IS NOT.
exercises.speakDone: BALANCE DONE. LESS WOBBLE THAN LAST MONTH. I NOTICED.

exercises.name: CAT-COW
exercises.cue: ALL FOURS, HANDS UNDER SHOULDERS, KNEES UNDER HIPS. INHALE: DROP THE BELLY, LIFT CHEST AND TAILBONE, EYES FORWARD (COW). EXHALE: ROUND THE SPINE UP, TUCK CHIN AND TAILBONE (CAT). SLOW, ONE BREATH EACH WAY.
exercises.speakStart: CAT COW. TWO ROUNDS OF EIGHT. BREATHE IN, BELLY DOWN, CHEST UP. BREATHE OUT, ROUND THE BACK LIKE AN ANGRY CAT. SLOW. ONE BREATH EACH WAY. YOUR FAVOURITE, GRIMES. DO NOT RUSH IT.
exercises.speakRest: FIFTEEN. SIT BACK ON YOUR HEELS.
exercises.speakDone: SPINE OILED. LOVELY. DO NOT TELL ANYONE I SAID LOVELY.

exercises.name: STAIR HAMSTRING STRETCH
exercises.cue: HEEL ON THE BOTTOM OR SECOND STAIR, LEG STRAIGHT BUT KNEE SOFT, TOES UP. HAND ON THE RAIL. KEEP THE BACK LONG AND HINGE FORWARD FROM THE HIPS UNTIL YOU FEEL THE BACK OF THE THIGH. NO BOUNCING. HOLD 30, SWITCH.
exercises.speakStart: HAMSTRING STRETCH. TWO ROUNDS. THIRTY SECONDS EACH SIDE. HEEL ON THE STEP, TOES UP, LONG BACK, LEAN FROM THE HIPS. NO BOUNCING. THOSE HAMSTRINGS ARE TIGHTER THAN A QUARTERMASTER'S WALLET.

exercises.name: FIGURE-FOUR HIP STRETCH
exercises.cue: SIT TALL ON A STURDY CHAIR OR LIE ON YOUR BACK. CROSS ONE ANKLE OVER THE OPPOSITE KNEE. KEEP THE SPINE LONG AND HINGE GENTLY FORWARD (OR DRAW THE KNEE IN) UNTIL YOU FEEL THE OUTER HIP AND GLUTE. BREATHE. HOLD 30, SWITCH.
exercises.speakStart: FIGURE FOUR. TWO ROUNDS. THIRTY SECONDS EACH SIDE. ANKLE OVER KNEE, LONG SPINE, LEAN IN GENTLY. BREATHE INTO THE OUTSIDE OF THE HIP. IF IT GRUMBLES, GOOD. THAT IS THE RUST TALKING.

exercises.name: WALL CHEST OPENER
exercises.cue: STAND SIDE-ON TO AN OPEN WALL. FOREARM ON THE WALL, ELBOW AT SHOULDER HEIGHT, BENT 90 DEGREES. STEP THE NEAR FOOT FORWARD AND GENTLY TURN THE CHEST AWAY FROM THE WALL UNTIL YOU FEEL THE FRONT OF THE SHOULDER AND CHEST OPEN. SHOULDER DOWN, BREATHE. HOLD 30, SWITCH.
exercises.speakStart: WALL CHEST OPENER. TWO ROUNDS. THIRTY SECONDS EACH SIDE. FOREARM ON THE WALL, ELBOW AT SHOULDER HEIGHT, TURN THE CHEST AWAY. SHOULDER DOWN, NOT UP BY YOUR EAR. UNDO A WEEK OF HUNCHING OVER THE KEYBOARD.
exercises.speakDone: CHEST OPEN. STAND TALL. THAT IS SUNDAY DONE. DISMISSED.
